messages.subject: Quick favor before I board
messages.preview: Boarding now, so I can't call. I need eight Apple gift cards...

body.text: Boarding now, so I can't call.
body.why: Pressure plus a reason you can't check. Classic.

body.text: I need eight Apple gift cards, $200 each, for client thank-yous.
body.why: Nobody at Harbor buys gift cards over email. Ever.

body.text: Scratch the backs and reply with the codes.
Don't loop in my assistant, it's a surprise.
body.why: Cutting out the person who could confirm it is the point.

header_tells.why: harborandco-exec.com is not harborandco.com. The name is free to fake. The address isn't.
Replies would go to a Gmail address, not to Harbor.
The EXTERNAL tag on mail from your own CFO means it came from outside Harbor.

verify.result: Elena picks up at her desk on 14. "Boarding? I'm right here. I didn't send that. Report it."

messages.reply_draft:
Hi Elena, here are the codes:

XXXX-XXXX-XXXX (x8)

Safe travels!

messages.subject: Action required: mailbox will be deleted in 24 hours
messages.preview: We could not verify your account. Sign in to keep your mailbox...

body.why: Your own IT knows your name.

body.text: We could not verify your account during the overnight security update.
Your mailbox and all files will be permanently deleted in 24 hours.
body.why: A deadline plus a threat is meant to stop you thinking.
The button says microsoftonline.com. The real link goes to verify-login.co.

header_tells.why: m365-harborandco.com is not a Microsoft or Harbor domain.
Real Harbor IT notices are internal. This one came from outside.

verify.result: The service desk picks up. "No mailbox checks tonight. Real IT notices come from it-notices@harborandco.com. Hit Report phish on it."
